title: PhotoAgent: Exploratory Visual Aesthetic Planning with Large Vision Models

layout.note: Two hand-drawn rounded frames side by side on top (narrow People-loop at the left, wide Agent-loop at the right) and a full-width strip of six photos with a black caption bar underneath.

lesson: Contrast a user-in-the-loop workflow with the autonomous one by framing both the same way, list the user's pain points as tinted complaint bubbles, draw the agent as a ring of coloured arcs with circled numbers around a mascot, and end with a photo strip under a caption bar that states the result.
